sources.label: hindu-devotional-texts 0.8.0 (npm), Lalitā Sahasranāma stotra and nāmāvalī
sources.note: Independent copy of the same recension used to cross-check every name, boundary and śloka; the two differ only where Appendix A/B of the study edition says.

translation.note: The English meanings, word tables, sandhi and samāsa analysis were prepared for PaddySpeaks in the 2026-10 study edition (lalitha-sahasranama/edition/). They are not taken from a published translation; interpretations that could not be confirmed are marked uncertain.

verification.method: Automated proof of the text: names exactly 1–1000 in order, each found inside the half-line that lists it, every half-line 16 syllables (anuṣṭubh), every IAST string the exact transliteration of its Devanagari, every logged correction present in the text.
verification.scope: internal consistency of edition/text.json and the analysis batches

verification.method: Name-by-name comparison with an independent copy of the same recension (hindu-devotional-texts 0.8.0): boundaries and spellings; every difference logged as a correction or a variant.

knownIssues.summary: Five variant readings (names 46, 107, 511, 547, 879) and 129 interpretations are flagged for review against a printed Saubhāgyabhāskara, which was not available when the edition was made. See lalitha-sahasranama/edition/CORRECTIONS.md.

statusNote: Text corrected and machine-proven (sequence, metre, transliteration, name-to-śloka alignment) in October 2026; not yet checked against a printed Saubhāgyabhāskara.
